title: Prop Firm Trader / Day Trader (FX/Crypto/Futures)
description:
Hello Traders!



Isla Capital is growing — and we’re looking for disciplined, serious traders to join our team of elite traders.



We work with experienced prop firm traders to trade evaluation and funded accounts through firms such as FTMO, Funded Elite, Alpha Capital Group, and similar platforms.



This opportunity is designed for Filipino professionals who understand prop firm rules, respect risk, and can trade with consistency and control.



Isla Capital is a structured, performance-driven, professional environment with a clear path toward higher earnings and long-term growth. Over time, this role will expand into live portfolio trading, where earning potential increases significantly. This is the place to develop into a professional trader.



What You’ll Do...



• Trade prop firm evaluation (challenge) accounts and funded accounts once evaluations are passed

• Strictly follow all prop firm rules and drawdown limits

• Maintain daily trading journals

• Provide consistent performance updates



What We’re Looking For...



• Experience trading prop firm accounts strongly preferred (or extensive live trading in lieu of prop firm experience)

• Strong risk management and discipline

• Ability to work independently

• Honest and reliable communication

• Understanding of scalping and/or day trading strategies



Compensation & Growth...



• Weekly base salary potential

• Bonus for passing evaluations / challenges

• Profit sharing on funded account payouts

• Performance bonuses based on payout milestones

• Access to in-house coaching from experienced traders

>> Upon certain milestones, we will also purchase additional prop accounts with copy trade software to multiply earnings



Important Notes...



• Accounts must be registered under the trader’s name (per prop firm rules), but all accounts and profits are part of Isla Capital

• All prop firm fees and account costs are fully covered by Isla Capital



Who This Is For...



This is a performance-first opportunity for traders who take their craft seriously.



We are building a system where disciplined Filipino traders can earn meaningful income and grow long-term within a structured trading environment.



If you are consistent, controlled, and committed — this could be a strong fit for you.



How to Apply...



Please apply and include:



• A short introduction about yourself

• Your prop firm experience and/or live brokerage trading

• Your trading style and psychology

• Resume or link to resume (if available)



Let's build something serious together!

title: Team Lead / Senior Technical QA — Architecture, BIM, or Construction Delivery Background
description:
# Team Lead / Senior Technical QA — Architecture, BIM, or Construction Delivery Background



**Remote | Philippines | Full-Time Contractor**



Oliant is looking for a strong **Team Lead / Senior Technical QA** professional in the Philippines to lead a growing remote team supporting construction technology, AI-assisted workflows, data quality, and project delivery.



This is not a basic QA role. We are looking for someone who understands construction drawings, project delivery, technical coordination, and quality standards — and who can lead a team with structure, patience, accountability, and strong communication.



The ideal candidate may come from an **Architecture, Civil Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, BIM, construction coordination, or technical QA** background.



## About the Role



As a **Team Lead / Senior Technical QA**, you will manage a team of junior technical QA associates and delivery specialists working across multiple projects. Your main responsibility is to ensure that the team produces accurate, timely, and high-quality work.



You will review project outputs, guide tea
mbers, identify quality issues, improve delivery processes, and act as the first escalation point when something needs clarification or correction.



This role is ideal for someone who enjoys combining technical construction knowledge with people leadership, quality control, and process improvement.



## What You’ll Do



Your responsibilities will include:



* Lead a team of junior technical QA associates and delivery specialists.

* Own the quality, accuracy, and timeliness of the team’s deliverables.

* Review work before it reaches the client or senior stakeholders.

* Ensure data accuracy, reporting consistency, and adherence to project standards.

* Help tea
mbers interpret construction drawings, 3D models, markups, RFIs, redlines, comments, and other technical documents.

* Support weekly workload planning and help assign tea
mbers based on project needs, skill level, and capacity.

* Maintain internal trackers, project status updates, and delivery documentation.

* Provide structured feedback to tea
mbers.

* Train junior tea
mbers on workflows, drawing interpretation, QA standards, platform usage, and delivery expectations.

* Identify recurring issues and recommend process improvements.

* Escalate blockers, risks, and quality concerns early.

* Coordinate with other remote teams involved in project setup, configuration, mapping, QA, and delivery.

* Participate in client-facing or internal stakeholder meetings when needed.

* Help create a culture of ownership, quality, accountability, and continuous improvement.



## What We’re Looking For



You should apply if you have:



* A Bachelor’s degree in **Architecture, Civil Engineering, Mechanical Engineering**, or a related construction / technical field.

* Strong ability to read and interpret construction drawings, including architectural plans, sections, MEP layouts, structural drawings, fit-out details, and site-related documentation.

* Experience with BIM, construction coordination, project delivery, technical QA, or quality control.

* Experience reviewing technical work for accuracy, completeness, and consistency.

* Strong attention to detail and the ability to catch mistakes before they become client-facing issues.

* Good English communication skills, both written and verbal.

* Experience leading, mentoring, training, or coordinating other tea
mbers.

* Strong ownership mindset and ability to work independently in a remote environment.

* Confidence working with spreadsheets, trackers, reports, and structured project data.

* Ability to learn new tools, platforms, and workflows quickly.



## Helpful Experience



The following experience is helpful, but not all are required:



* Autodesk Revit

* AutoCAD

* Navisworks / NWD model navigation

* BIM 360 / Autodesk Construction Cloud

* Bluebeam

* Procore

* Google Sheets / Microsoft Excel

* Primavera P6 or ASTA Powerproject

* Construction progress tracking

* QA process design

* Data validation

* AI-assisted workflows

* Remote team leadership



## Who You Are



We are looking for someone who is:



* Detail-oriented and quality-driven.

* Calm under pressure.

* Clear and respectful when giving feedback.

* Comfortable holding people accountable without micromanaging.

* Proactive in raising risks, blockers, and process gaps.

* Able to explain complex technical issues in simple terms.

* Fair, patient, and supportive with junior tea
mbers.

* Comfortable working with changing priorities.

* Interested in technology, AI, construction data, and modern digital workflows.



## Compensation



* **Starting compensation:** **$950 – $1,100 USD/month**, depending on experience and interview performance.

* **Strong candidates with proven leadership, BIM, construction coordination, or QA management experience may be considered up to:** **$1,200 USD/month**.

* Compensation is reviewed based on performance, reliability, quality of work, leadership, communication, and business needs.



This is a full-time contractor role. Weekend or rest-day work may be required depending on project needs and will be handled separately according to the project schedule and applicable rate structure.



## Role Details



* **Location:** Fully remote, Philippines

* **Type:** Full-time contractor

* **Schedule:** Full-time

* **Seniority:** Lead / Senior Technical QA

* **Reports to:** Delivery / Operations Management

* **Team:** You will help lead a growing team of junior technical QA associates and delivery specialists.



## Why Join Oliant?



Oliant works with international clients and remote teams across multiple regions. We are building specialized teams around AI-assisted QA, technical validation, construction data, digital workflows, and project delivery.



This is a strong opportunity for someone who wants to move beyond individual production work and grow into a leadership role where quality, communication, process improvement, and team development matter.



You will help shape how the team works, how quality is maintained, and how junior technical talent grows.



## How to Apply



Please send your resume and a short introduction that includes:



1. Your background in Architecture, Engineering, BIM, construction coordination, or QA.

2. The tools you have used, such as Revit, AutoCAD, Navisworks, BIM 360, Procore, Bluebeam, Excel, or similar platforms.

3. Your experience reviewing drawings, models, reports, or technical project data.

4. Any experience leading, mentoring, training, or coordinating tea
mbers.

5. Your expected monthly compensation in USD.



We are looking for someone who can lead with quality, ownership, and good judgment. If that sounds like you, we would be happy to hear from you.

title: URGENT Loan Data Analyst
description:
About the Role



We are an Australian-based private lender seeking a highly detail-oriented Loan Data Analyst with experience working alongside credit decisioning frameworks or rule books.



This role goes beyond basic data review — you will play a key part in structuring financial data in line with credit policy, ensuring our assessors can make fast, consistent, and responsible lending decisions.



Key Responsibilities



• Review and analyse customer bank transaction data (last 90 days)

• Categorise income, expenses, and liabilities in line with internal credit rules

• Apply and interpret credit policy / rulebook guidelines to real customer data

• Identify financial behaviours such as:



Gambling activity

BNPL usage

Payday lending / wage advances

Overdraft reliance

• Prepare clear, structured summaries aligned to decisioning requirements

• Flag inconsistencies, risks, or policy breaches for escalation

• Support continuous improvement of credit rules and data structuring processes

• Maintain strict privacy, confidentiality, and data handling standards

What We’re Looking For



• Experience working with credit rulebooks, decisioning frameworks, or lending policies

• Background in lending, fintech, credit risk, or financial data analysis

• Strong understanding of:



Income verification

Expense analysis

Liability assessment

Responsible lending principles

• Proven ability to identify patterns, anomalies, and risk indicators in transaction data

• High attention to detail and structured thinking

• Ability to follow and apply rules consistently (not just interpret data)

• Strong written English and ability to present clear, logical summaries

Important – Privacy & Data Handling



You will be working with sensitive financial data. All work must be completed in line with strict privacy and confidentiality requirements.

No customer data is to be stored, shared, or used outside of authorised systems.



Application Requirement (Mandatory)



To be considered for this role, you must provide:



A sample of a credit rulebook, decisioning framework, or policy you have previously worked with

This can be anonymised or redacted if required

It should demonstrate how decisions are made (e.g. income rules, expense thresholds, risk flags)

Examples of categorised transaction data, ensuring:

All personal information is removed or anonymised

No real customer names, account numbers, or identifiable details

Clear grouping of transactions (e.g. income, rent, utilities, gambling, BNPL, discretionary spending)



Applications without these examples will not be considered.



Why Join Us?



• Work with a fast-growing Australian lender building a scalable credit model

• Be part of a structured, data-driven decisioning environment

• Long-term opportunity with growth into credit risk and policy development

• High-impact role influencing how lending decisions are made

title: Human Resources (HR) Lead
description:
We are hiring a highly organized, detail-oriented Human Resources Lead to support a fast-growing, multi-location franchise education business in the U.S.



This is not a basic VA role — you will act as the operational backbone for HR, payroll coordination, onboarding, compliance, and related administrative systems across multiple locations.



Your job is to reduce chaos, streamline workflows, and ensure clean execution across HR as we scale.



Key Responsibilities



HR Operations & Employee Lifecycle

• Manage onboarding for new hires (offer letters, document collection, file organization)

• Maintain employee records and ensure all documentation is complete and compliant with California employment laws

• Support offboarding processes (terminations, final pay coordination, documentation)

• Track employee status across locations (active, onboarding, terminated)



Payroll Coordination (Paylocity)

• Prepare and coordinate payroll runs

• Handle off-cycle payroll adjustments, corrections, and updates

• Maintain employee data (direct deposit, classifications, etc.)

• Work with U.S. payroll provider (Paylocity) to resolve issues



Systems & Benefits Administration

• Support Paylocity setup and ongoing maintenance (T&L, policies, configurations)

• Assist with benefits coordination (401k, benefit platforms, etc.)

• Troubleshoot system issues and follow up persistently until resolved

• Help document and improve HR/payroll workflows



Compliance & Entity Setup Support

• Assist with: EIN applications, State registrations (e.g., EDD), Business licenses

• Maintain compliance tracking (deadlines, filings, documentation)

• Conduct basic research on HR/payroll/legal requirements as needed



Admin & Operations Support

• Manage shared tools (Google Drive, tracking sheets, task lists)

• Coordinate across tea
mbers (operations, finance, leadership)

• Reduce
 chaos by organizing and executing tasks efficiently

• Ad-hoc personal requests from owner



Reporting & Process Improvement

• Maintain clean tracking sheets for: Payroll status, Onboarding progress, Compliance items

• Identify inefficiencies and propose improvements

• Help build simple, scalable SOPs for all recurring tasks



Ideal Candidate Profile

• 3–6+ years experience working in Human Resources roles.

• Experience working with U.S.-based businesses (required), with experience in California-based businesses a significant nice-to-have

• Familiarity with: Payroll systems (Paylocity strongly preferred); HR processes (onboarding, terminations, employee records)

• Highly organized with strong attention to detail

• Strong written English communication (clear, concise, professional)

• Able to work independently and drive tasks to completion without handholding



Nice to Have

• Experience supporting multi-location or franchise businesses

• Familiarity with tools like: Paylocity, Ramp, Google Sheets (intermediate level)

• Experience improving workflows or building SOPs

• Basic knowledge of U.S. labor/payroll compliance



Success Metrics

• Payroll runs smoothly with minimal errors or rework

• Employee onboarding/offboarding is clean, fast, and fully documented

• Minimal back-and-forth required to complete tasks

• Systems (Paylocity, tracking sheets) are clean and up-to-date

• Communication is clear, proactive, and reduces leadership time



Time Tracking

• You will be asked to maintain a simple Google Sheet time tracker that tracks your time spent by project

description:
SECTION 1 — POSITION OVERVIEW



Position Title:

Virtual Assistant (VA) Leasing Agent — Reiger World Apartments



Reports To:

Property Manager / Collins Properties



Employment Type:

Remote / Contract | Part-Time or Full-Time (based on vacancy volume)



Work Hours:

Monday – Friday 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM CST | Saturday (as needed for open house support)



Location:

Fully remote — all work performed digitally via
, phone, video, and leasing platforms



Position Summary

The Virtual Assistant (VA) Leasing Agent supports Reiger World Apartments' aggressive 90-day lease-up campaign by managing all remote leasing activities: online listings, lead intake and follow-up, application coordination, digital marketing, and administrative reporting. The VA operates as a high-output remote extension of the on-site leasing team, handling the volume and follow-through that drives occupancy while the on-site agent focuses on tours and closings.

With 23 current vacancies, speed and consistency are critical. The VA is expected to work all active lead channels simultaneously, respond to inquiries within 2 hours, and maintain meticulous records in the leasing pipeline tracker.



SECTION 2 — KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



A. Online Listings & Platform Management

• Manage and refresh listings daily on GoSection8, 
, HousingList, Zillow,
 Marketplace, and Nextdoor

• Upload current unit photos, availability, rates (GPI and concession pricing), and community benefits

• Remove filled units promptly; add new vacancies within 24 hours of notice

• Monitor platfor
ssage inboxes and respond to all inquiries within 2 hours



B. Lead Management & Follow-Up

• Log every incoming lead (source, contact info, unit interest, voucher status) into the pipeline tracker

• Send introduction messages and property info packets to all new inquiries

• Follow up with all unscheduled prospects via phone, text, and
 every 48–72 hours

• Schedule unit tours for the on-site leasing agent; send prospect confirmations and 24-hour reminders

• Track every prospect through the pipeline: New ? Contacted ? Toured ? Applied ? Approved ? Leased



C. Section 8 & Affordable Housing Outreach

• Contact local Dallas-area housing authorities and Section 8 offices to list the property on voucher-holder resources

• Communicate with housing counselors and case managers to identify pre-qualified voucher holders

• Assist applicants with Section 8 paperwork questions; coordinate inspection scheduling with on-site agent

• Maintain up-to-date knowledge of Dallas Housing Authority payment standards for 1BR and 2BR units



D. Digital Marketing & Social Media

• Create and publish 3–5 social media posts per week 
, Instagram, Nextdoor)

• Promote open houses, concession tiers, and community benefits through digital content

• Boost high-performing posts or listings as directed by Property Manager

• Track engagement metrics and report weekly on which platforms generate the most leads



E. Application & Lease Administration

• Distribute rental applications via
 or online portal to qualified prospects

• Follow up with applicants for missing documentation; track application completeness

• Coordinate with screening vendor for background and credit checks

• Prepare lease packets for approved applicants using Collins Properties templates

• Send leases via DocuSign or HelloSign; track e-signature completion

• Confirm move-in date, deposit receipt, and utility setup with on-site agent



F. Reporting & Communication

• Deliver a daily end-of-day summary
 to Property Manager: leads received, contacts made, tours booked

• Submit a comprehensive weekly leasing report every Friday: KPIs, pipeline status, concession usage, recommendations

• Flag units vacant 30+ days for concession tier upgrade review

• Maintain all records in the shared Collins Properties Google Drive or Buildium file system



SECTION 3 — QUALIFICATIONS & SKILLS



Required

• Minimum 1 year of remote administrative, leasing support, or property management experience

• Proficiency in Microsoft Office / Google Workspace (Excel/Sheets, Word/Docs, Gmail)

• Strong written communication skills — professional
s and messages are the primary work product

• Experience managing multiple online platforms simultaneously

• Reliable high-speed internet, computer, and phone/VOIP capability

• Highly organized with the ability to manage a large prospect pipeline independently

• Ability to work US Central Time hours (8 AM – 5 PM CST)



Preferred

• Prior experience with GoSection8, 
, or similar affordable housing listing platforms

• Familiarity with Section 8 / Housing Choice Voucher programs and Dallas Housing Authority processes

• Experience supporting leasing for senior (55+) or affordable housing communities

• Proficiency in DocuSign, HelloSign, or similar e-signature platforms

• Social media content creation and scheduling experience

• Basic knowledge of Buildium, AppFolio, or similar property management software

• Bilingual English/Spanish strongly preferred for serving Dallas-area Section 8 population



SECTION 4 — REQUIRED TOOLS & PLATFORMS



The VA Leasing Agent must be proficient in or able to quickly learn the following:



Category Tools / Platforms

Lead Generation & Listings -  GoSection8, 
, HousingList, Zillow,
 Marketplace, Nextdoor

CRM / Tracking - Google Sheets Vacancy Tracker, Buildium (if granted access), or custom Collins Properties template

Communication -
 (Gmail/Outlook), WhatsApp Business, Google Voice or VOIP line for prospect calls

Social Media -
, Instagram, Nextdoor; Buffer or Meta Business Suite for scheduling

Document Management - Google Drive, DocuSign or HelloSign for e-lease execution, Dropbox for file sharing

Screening Coordination - TransUnion SmartMove, RentPrep, or manager-assigned screening vendor

Project Management - Trello, Asana, or ClickUp for daily task tracking and manager visibility

Reporting - Google Sheets or Excel weekly leasing report;
ed to Collins Properties every Friday



SECTION 5 — COMPENSATION & INCENTIVES



Base Pay Monthly -  retainer or hourly rate based on experience and hours worked

Per-Lease Bonus - $50–$75 per executed lease generated through VA's lead activity

Occupancy Milestone - $250 bonus when property reaches 90% occupancy within 60 days

Referral Conversion - $25 per referral lead that converts to a signed lease

Platform Performance - Bonus eligibility if online inquiry volume increases 25%+ month-over-month



SECTION 6 — PERFORMANCE METRICS (KPIs)



The VA Leasing Agent will be evaluated weekly and monthly on the following metrics:



KPI Metric

Lead Inquiries Logged - Weekly Target 25+, Monthly Target 100+

Tours Booked (for on-site agent), Weekly Target 10+, Monthly Target 40+

Follow-Up Contacts Made - Weekly Target 30+, Monthly Target 120+

Applications Submitted - Weekly Target 5+, Monthly Target 20+

Listing Refreshes Completed - Weekly Target All platforms All platforms

Social Media Posts Published - Weekly Target 3–5, Monthly Targe 12–20

Section 8 / HA Contacts Made - Weekly Target 10+, Monthly Targe 40+

Lease Packets Prepared - Weekly Target Per approvals, Monthly Targe Per approvals

Weekly Report Delivered - Weekly Target Every Friday, Monthly Targe 4x/month

Lead Response Time - Weekly Target < 2 hours, Monthly Targe < 2 hours



SECTION 7 — OPERATING PROTOCOLS & STANDARDS



Communication Standards

• All prospect inquiries must receive a response within 2 hours during business hours

• Use approved Collins Properties
 templates for initial outreach; personalize as appropriate

• Never make lease approval promises — direct applicants to Property Manager for final decisions

• Maintain a professional, warm tone in all communications — remember the target audience is seniors 55+



Data & Confidentiality

• All applicant data (SSN, income, background info) must be handled per Fair Housing and privacy guidelines

• Never store sensitive applicant data on personal devices — use only approved shared drives

• Prospect and tenant contact info is proprietary — not to be shared outside Collins Properties



Escalation Protocol

• Escalate any Fair Housing complaints, threatening communications, or legal questions to Property Manager immediately

• Flag any prospect with unusual circumstances (complex voucher situations, disability accommodations) to on-site agent

• If a listing platform flags the property or suspends a listing, notify manager within 1 hour

title: Marketing Systems Builder & Lead Generation Specialist
description:
Job Title: Marketing Systems Builder & Lead Generation Specialist



Location: Remote



Hours: Monday–Friday, 8–5 Central Standard Time. Full Time (40 hours per week.)



Company Overview



Meridian AI is a fast-growing US-based company serving the insurance industry. We help insurance agencies turn cold and dormant leads into booked appointments through AI-powered automation and outreach. We are in an exciting build phase, laying the foundation for something that scales, and we are looking for one sharp, organized person to help us stand up our marketing systems and then run them to generate a steady flow of qualified leads. This is a long-term role with real ownership and room to grow alongside the company.



Role Summary



As our Marketing Systems Builder and Lead Generation Specialist, you own an outcome, not a checklist: a full pipeline of qualified leads. This role blends systems building with hands-on execution. You will set up our outreach infrastructure, run it day to day, and document everything into clean, repeatable processes as we grow. It is best suited for someone who is self-directed, takes ownership of results, and thrives without needing a lot of oversight to perform at a high level. You will be guided closely at the start while you learn our business, then take the wheel and run.



Primary Responsibilities



-Set up and run cold
 campaigns end to end, including infrastructure, deliverability, sequences, monitoring, and optimization.

-Build and manage LinkedIn outreach automation to consistently generate qualified leads.

-Refine lead magnets and case study assets to improve conversion.

-Document the systems you build into clear, repeatable SOPs as the company grows.

-Report on performance and adjust to continually improve results.



Candidate Requirements



-Demonstrated experience building cold
 or outreach systems from scratch, with results you can show.

-Obsessively organized, with strong documentation habits and an eye for clean process.

-Highly self-motivated with the ability to manage your time and performance without daily oversight.

-Comfortable being guided closely at first, then taking full ownership and running independently.

-Strong written English and clear, professional communication.

-Familiarity with cold
 platforms (Instantly, Smartlead, or similar) and LinkedIn automation tools. GoHighLevel experience is a plus.

-Reliable computer and internet connection required.



Compensation



-Competitive monthly salary based on experience, with raises as you take on more ownership.

-Full-time contractor position (40 hours per week).

-Flexible, remote working environment.

-On-the-job training and opportunities for professional development and growth within the company.



Our Culture

title: Social Media Manager
description:
Social Media Manager — Role & Playbook

Business: Website design for restaurants & local businesses Platforms: Instagram (primary), TikTok,
 The one job: Grow a relevant audience and turn it into DMs ? qualified leads ? paying clients.



The Goal (read this first)

Follower count is not the goal. The goal is DMs from restaurant owners that turn into paying clients. A 2,000-follower account full of local restaurant owners beats a 50,000-follower account full of random people every single time. At the same time this does not mean we do not want to grow the account the more followers we have the higher chance we can turn viewers and followers into leads.

Every post must do one of three jobs: get discovered (Top of Funnel), build trust (Middle of Funnel), or drive a DM (Bottom of Funnel). If a post does none of these, don't post it.

North-star metric: number of qualified DMs / leads passed to the owner per week. Secondary metrics: shares, saves, profile visits, follower growth (relevant followers only). Vanity metrics to ignore: raw likes, total followers without context.



The Funnel — what to post and how much

Use this mix as the default. Early on (under ~2k followers) lean heavier on Top of Funnel to grow reach; once the audience builds, shift more toward Middle and Bottom.

Funnel tier

% of posts

Goal

Metric that proves it worked

Top (TOFU)

~50%

Get discovered by people who don't know us

Reach, shares, new follows

Middle (MOFU)

~30%

Prove we know our stuff

Saves, comments, profile visits

Bottom (BOFU)

~20%

Turn warm followers into DMs

DMs, link clicks, leads



TOP OF FUNNEL — Viral Hooks, Broad Topics, Shares

Purpose: reach strangers and get shared. These are broad, visual, and satisfying. No selling.

Content types:

Before/after redesigns of real restaurant sites

"Redesigning a real local restaurant" series — pick a local spot with a bad site, rebuild it, reveal the transformation (this is the flagship format)

Speed builds — sped-up "watch me build a restaurant site in 60 seconds"

Broad relatable hooks about bad restaurant websites

Hook bank (the first 1–2 seconds d
 everything):

"This restaurant has amazing food and a website that's quietly killing their business."

"I redesigned a local restaurant's website without them asking — here's what I changed."

"POV: you Google a restaurant and this is their website."

"Your restaurant's website is losing you customers every day. Here's proof."

MIDDLE OF FUNNEL — Education, Frameworks, Saves

Purpose: convince people who found us that we're the expert. Useful enough to save and send to a friend.

Content types:

Frameworks: "5 things every restaurant website needs (most miss #3)"

Mistakes: "3 things wrong with most restaurant websites"

Myth-busting: "Why relying on just a
 page is costing you money"

Mini-explainers: online ordering, mobile speed, Google rankings — in plain English

Hook bank:

"5 things every restaurant website needs — most are missing at least two."

"The 3-second test: if your site fails this, you're losing diners."

"Stop relying on DoorDash for your online presence. Here's why."

BOTTOM OF FUNNEL — Client Wins, Hard Pitches, DMs

Purpose: turn warm followers into conversations. Direct, proof-driven, with a clear next step.

Content types:

Client wins / results: "We rebuilt [restaurant]'s site and their online orders went up — here's how."

Transparent breakdowns: "Here's exactly what we did for this restaurant and what it cost."

Direct offers: the comment-to-DM play (below)

Hook bank:

"We rebuilt this restaurant's website. Look at the difference."

"Comment SITE and I'll send you a free preview of your restaurant's new website."

"Want to see what your restaurant's site could look like? DM us 'WEBSITE'."



The Weekly Posting Schedule

Start at 5 posts/week (one per weekday), batched and scheduled a week ahead. Same vertical video gets posted to all three platforms — produce once, repurpose everywhere.

Day

Funnel

Post

Monday

TOFU

Before/after of a recent build

Tuesday

MOFU

Educational framework / mistakes post

Wednesday

TOFU

Redesign series — Part 1 (the bad site + "let's fix it")

Thursday

BOFU

Client win / testimonial / results

Friday

TOFU

Redesign series — Part 2 (the reveal) + soft CTA



Rotate so that over two weeks you hit roughly 6 TOFU, 2 MOFU, 2 BOFU. To push more leads, swap a TOFU slot for a second BOFU once the audience is warm.



The Social Media Manager's Exact Responsibilities

Every week (planning — sent to owner for approval)

Build the week's content calendar: what posts, which funnel tier, what day.

Write the script and hook for each post (the spoken/on-screen lines).

Write the caption and CTA for each post.

Edit the raw footage the owner provides into finished vertical reels — captions, hook on screen, trending audio, tight pacing, strong first frame.

Schedule every post across Instagram, TikTok, and
.

Every day

Confirm the scheduled post went live on all three platforms.

Engage in the first 60 minutes after posting — reply to every comment (this is when reach is d
).

Reply to all DMs. Qualify lightly, log every lead in the tracker, and flag warm ones to the owner immediately.

Spend 20–30 min commenting on target accounts — local restaurants, local business pages, food bloggers — to get the account in front of the right people.

Every month

Report: follower growth, top posts, saves/shares, DMs, leads passed. Note what worked and adjust the mix.



How to Gain REAL Followers (not junk)

Tag the restaurant in every redesign. When you feature a real local spot, tag them — they often reshare to their own followers (their customers and other owners). This is the single best source of relevant reach.

Use local + niche tags: location tags for the city/region, plus restaurant/local-business hashtags. Skip giant generic tags.

Reply to every comment and DM. Conversation tells the algorithm the content matters, and it builds real relationships.

Be consistent. 5 posts every week beats 15 one week and none the next.

Never buy followers, likes, or use engagement pods. It poisons your reach and brings zero buyers.



The DM ? Lead Handoff (where the money is)

This is the whole point. The conversion mechanic:

BOTTOM-of-funnel posts end with a comment-to-DM call to action — "Comment SITE and I'll send you a free preview."

Use a tool like ManyChat to auto-DM everyone who comments the keyword. This spikes engagement and drops a warm lead straight into the inbox.

The SMM responds, asks 1–2 light qualifying questions (restaurant name, do they have a site now), and logs the lead in the tracker.

Anyone who shows real interest gets flagged to the owner to close.

Every DM is a potential client. The SMM's job is to start the conversation and hand the owner someone ready to talk.



What the Owner Provides

The SMM can't build the websites — that's you. Your weekly input is small:

Raw footage: screen recordings of builds, before/after captures, the occasional talking-head hook. Batch it once a week into a shared folder.

Approve the calendar the SMM sends.

Close the warm leads the SMM hands you.



Tools

Scheduling:Google Calendar (or the free native Instagram/TikTok schedulers)

Editing: CapCut

Comment-to-DM automation: ManyChat

Content calendar + lead log: Google Sheets or Notion (shared with the owner)



The Rule That Keeps Everyone Honest

Posts are judged by leads, not likes. A post with 200 likes and zero DMs failed. A post with 30 likes that produced two DMs from restaurant owners succeeded. Optimize relentlessly for the conversation, not the applause. We still do need followers, likes, and shares. It is not okay to not get leads or likes.

title: Investment Analyst
description:
Investment Analyst — CERTUM Strategic Tax & Wealth Advisory / Premier Affordable Housing Fund



Full-Time | Remote | Immediate Start



About the Company

CERTUM is a premium tax and wealth advisory firm serving business owners, high-net-worth families, and sophisticated investors. We specialize in proactive tax architecture, wealth structuring, and advanced financial planning — not compliance work. Our clients come to us when they're ready to play at a different level.



Alongside the advisory firm, we operate Premier Affordable Housing Fund (PAHF) — a real estate investment fund focused on workforce and affordable housing across high-yield Midwest markets — and a property portfolio spanning hundreds of units. We acquire, reposition, and operate cash-flowing real estate using disciplined underwriting, value-add strategies, and tax-advantaged structures.



The founder, Jamal Hansen, is also a well-known content creator and educator in the tax, wealth, and investing space, with a large and growing audience across Instagram and YouTube where he teaches high earners and business owners how the wealthy actually build and protect money. Before you apply, go check 
 on Instagram and his YouTube channel — that content will tell you exactly who you'd be working for and the level we operate at. The platform is also a real part of the business: it drives clients, capital, and brand partnerships, so you're joining a company that is both an operator and a media presence.



About the Role



You will work directly with the founder, Jamal Hansen — a successful entrepreneur managing multiple companies across tax, real estate, and investments. Your job is to be the analytical engine behind our deals: underwriting acquisitions, building the models, and pressure-testing every number before capital goes to work.



This is not a passive spreadsheet job. We are evaluating deals, raising capital, and acquiring real estate at the same time, often on tight timelines. You need to be the person who can take a raw deal, build a clean model, and tell us in plain language whether it works and where the risk is. If you need every assumption handed to you, this isn't the right fit. If you think in numbers, take ownership of your analysis, and can defend it, keep reading.



As the fund and the portfolio grow, this role grows with it. You will be taught our underwriting frameworks and the tax strategy that sits underneath every deal — but you have to be coachable and genuinely eager to learn. The exposure you'll get sitting at the intersection of real estate, fund operations, and advanced tax strategy is not something you'll pick up anywhere else. We're looking for world-class A-players who want to build something and grow with the company long-term.

This role is vital to the next evolution of the company.



Key Responsibilities



Underwrite real estate acquisitions — build and maintain financial models and pro formas for single-asset and portfolio deals, including BRRRR, value-add, and Section 8 / HCV workforce housing

Run the numbers on every deal — purchase price, rehab, financing, rents, expenses, exit, and returns (IRR, equity multiple, cash-on-cash, DSCR)



Conduct market research and comps on target Midwest markets — rents, vacancy, cap rates, neighborhood and demand trends



Perform deal due diligence — review T-12s, rent rolls, offering memos, and operating statements and flag anything that doesn't add up



Support PAHF fund operations — assist with deal pipeline tracking, investor reporting inputs, and capital deployment analysis

Build and maintain dashboards and trackers for portfolio performance across the property base

Incorporate tax strategy into analysis where relevant — cost segregation, bonus depreciation, and how structure affects investor returns

Prepare clear, decision-ready summaries — turn a full model into a one-page read that tells us go or no-go and why

Take on new analytical responsibilities as the fund and portfolio scale





Who You Are



You are genuinely strong with numbers and financial modeling — this is the core of the role, not a nice-to-have

You are detail-obsessed — you catch the broken formula, the wrong assumption, the number that doesn't tie

You can think independently and form a point of view, not just fill in a template

You can explain a complex model in plain English to someone who isn't going to read every cell

You move fast without getting sloppy and you take ownership of your work

You are coachable, hungry to learn, and want to grow inside a multi-company operation long-term

You are fully fluent in written and spoken English — this is non-negotiable for this role





Requirements



Advanced proficiency in Excel and / or Google Sheets — comfortable building models from scratch (this will be tested)

Demonstrated ability to build pro formas and understand real estate or investment returns

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with high attention to detail

Background or strong interest in real estate, finance, accounting, or investments

Reliable high-speed internet, a quiet work environment, and availability during agreed working hours

Full written and spoken English fluency — non-negotiable





Training & Development



Comprehensive training will be provided on our underwriting frameworks, models, and tools before you are expected to execute independently

As new responsibilities are added to this role you will be fully trained on how to complete them before they become part of your regular duties

Certain analyses will be repeated consistently so you will have the opportunity to master them and become the go-to expert in that area

Jamal will personally invest time in teaching you how deals are evaluated across the fund and the portfolio so you understand not just what to model but why it matters

Training materials, SOPs, model templates, and video walkthroughs will be provided and stored in the company Notion and Google Drive library for ongoing reference

You are not expected to know everything on day one — you are expected to learn, apply, and grow





The Opportunity

You won't be buried in a corporate structure. You'll be in the room, seeing how a multi-company operation evaluates and acquires real assets at a high level, and growing with it.

There is real room to grow here for someone who performs.



How to Apply

All applications go through our application form — we will not be accepting resumes by
.



Fill out the form here: 







You'll be asked to provide:



A brief introduction — who you are and why this role makes sense for you right now

Your resume or professional profile link

A link to or screenshot of a financial model, pro forma, or analysis you've built (if you don't have one, briefly describe a deal or number you analyzed and what you concluded)

A short voice or video introduction (60 seconds or less) so we can hear how you communicate



Only applications submitted through the form will be reviewed.

A closer handles the rest. Most people don't have the discipline for this. The ones who do will earn well and grow with us.

- Phone confidence - comfortable starting conversations with business owners cold.

- Excellent written and spoken English

- A self-starter who manages their own activity without hand-holding

- Hungry - you want to earn commission on every meeting that closes



Bonus Points If You Have:

- Set appointments for home services / trades / local business owners

- Worked for a digital/marketing agency or B2B service business

- Experience with GoHighLevel (GHL)

- Comfortable with SMS/text and
 outreach alongside phone calls

- AI tools in your daily workflow (ChatGPT, Claude, etc.)



You must be able to work US business hours (8am–5pm HST / 11pm–8am PHT). This is a firm requirement - not flexible.



Employment:

Part-time or full-time (40 hrs/week), long-term only. We're not interested in job-hoppers.



Compensation:

Uncapped commission. Base starting 30k-50k PHP/month + commission per closed deal that you set + residual recurring commission (Wise/Payoneer paid bi-weekly). Top setters double their base monthly when the closer converts. 13th month considered for long-term hires.



HOW TO APPLY (FOLLOW EXACTLY - IF YOU CAN'T FOLLOW DIRECTIONS, YOU CAN'T BOOK FOR US)



- Use 7 apply points 

-
 subject must start with "SDR777" and include your name

- Number your answers 1–7 as outlined below.



1) How many outbound dials per day are you comfortable making?

2) Are you a setter, a closer, or both? Be honest.

3) How many meetings have you personally booked? Give us real numbers (meetings set, show rate, deal outcomes if known).

Applications without all items above and proper subject won't be opened.



We're looking for someone who takes pride in filling calendars. If that's you, we want to hear from you.

v, Cursor, Bolt, Replit, Supabase, Vercel, or similar tools** is a strong plus.

title: Internal Audit Consultant
description:
Cherry Hill Advisory is seeking a motivated internal audit practitioner to execute co-sourced audit engagements, quality assessments, fraud investigations, and enterprise risk management projects across a diverse global client base. You will work embedded within CHA engagement teams, delivering rigorous fieldwork under the supervision of senior practitioners and former CAEs. This role offers broad exposure across industries and engagement types with a clear path toward senior consultant and specialty roles.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

• Execute co-sourced internal audit engagements from planning through fieldwork, findings, and reporting across a wide range of industries and process areas.

• Support External Quality Assessments (EQA) and Self-Assessment with Independent Validation (SAIV) engagements, including

document review, interview support, and conformance analysis against IIA Standards.

• Assist with fraud risk assessments and fraud investigations: evidence gathering, transaction analysis, control failure identification, and investigation workpaper preparation.

• Contribute to Enterprise Risk Management engagements including risk workshops, risk register development, heat map

construction, and ERM framework gap analysis.

• Produce workpapers to CHA quality standards: clear objective, steps performed, evidence attached, conclusion stated, and

reviewer-ready.

• Draft initial findings with full CCCE structure for senior review and client issuance.

• Coordinate evidence requests with client process owners; maintain open item trackers and status schedules.

• Actively pursue CIA, CPA, or an internationally recognized certification aligned to your development plan.



ABOUT CHERRY HILL ADVISORY

Cherry Hill Advisory is a global practitioner-built internal audit and risk advisory firm led by former CAEs and Big Four alumni. We deliver co-sourced internal audit, EQA conformance, SOC 2 readiness, ERM, fraud risk management, SOX compliance, cybersecurity, and AI governance. IIA Authorized Licensee. NASBA-accredited CPE provider.



REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• 1-3 years of internal audit, external audit, or risk advisory experience

• Working knowledge of COSO internal control framework and IIA Standards

• Strong analytical skills and disciplined workpaper documentation habits

• Professional-level English proficiency, written and verbal

• Bachelor's degree in accounting, finance, business, or information systems from an accredited institution



PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• CIA candidate or certified; CPA or internationally recognized equivalent (ACCA, CPC, or national designation)

• Public accounting, advisory, or Big Four background

• Exposure to fraud investigation, ERM, or quality assessment engagements

ENGAGEMENT TERMS

• All work performed remotely; client meetings via video conference

• International candidates welcome; US time zone overlap required

configuration controls.

mber who lives at the intersection of creative content production and digital marketing execution.

title: Remote Appointment Setter / Warm Lead Caller for Family-Owned Memorial Business
description:
We are a family-owned monument and memorial business in the United States. We help families with cemetery memorials, headstones, monuments, and related appointments.



We are looking for a part-time appointment setter / warm lead caller for approximately 15–20 hours per week.



This is an outbound calling role, but it is not a high-pressure sales job. We are not looking for someone aggressive. We need someone who sounds natural, patient, professional, respectful, and trustworthy on the phone.



Some people may be older, busy, emotional, or not ready to talk. The right person must be able to have a respectful conversation, ask simple questions, handle objections politely, and help set appointments for our memorial specialist when there is real interest.



This is a separate outbound calling and appointment-setting role. It is not the same as an office coordinator/admin position.



Main Responsibilities:



You will help with:



- Making outbound calls to company-provided leads

- Following up with people who may need monument, headstone, or cemetery memorial help

- Calling past leads, old quotes, cemetery leads, or other company-provided lists

- Asking simple qualifying questions

- Setting appointments for our memorial specialist

- Leaving professional voi
s when appropriate

- Taking clear call notes

- Updating a call tracker, spreadsheet, or CRM

- Marking call outcomes accurately

- Following a respectful script while still sounding natural

- Handling basic objections politely

- Escalating interested or sensitive situations to our team



The Right Person:



We are looking for someone who is:



- Clear and easy to understand on the phone

- Warm, calm, and respectful

- Confident but not pushy

- Comfortable making outbound calls

- Good with older customers

- Able to handle rejection without sounding discouraged

- Organized with notes and follow-up

- Reliable during scheduled hours

- Comfortable using scripts, spreadsheets, and call trackers

- Comfortable starting part-time



Required Skills:



- Excellent spoken English

- Phone support or outbound calling experience

- Appointment-setting experience preferred

- Customer service experience

- Ability to take clear notes

- Google Sheets or Excel

- Reliable internet

- Quiet work environment

- Backup internet or power preferred



Bonus Experience:



Please mention if you have experience with any of these:



- Appointment setting

- Cold calling

- Warm lead calling

- Real estate ISA work

- Insurance appointment setting

- Home services calling

- Healthcare or senior customer service

- Funeral home, cemetery, or memorial-related work

- Calling U.S. customers

- Handling objections

- CRM or call-tracking tools



Schedule:



15–20 hours per week.



Calls will be made during U.S. Central Time business hours. Exact schedule can be discussed, but availability during weekday U.S. daytime hours is important. Morning availability in Central Time is preferred.



Pay:



Pay depends on experience, phone quality, schedule, and performance.



Please include your desired hourly rate in your application.



There may also be an opportunity for performance bonuses after a successful trial period.



Application Instructions:



To apply, please reply with the word CALLER at the top of your message.



Then answer these questions:



1. Are you available to work 15–20 hours per week during U.S. Central Time business hours?

2. What is your desired hourly rate?

3. Describe your outbound calling, appointment-setting, cold-calling, or phone support experience.

4. What types of leads or customers have you called before?

5. Tell us about a time you handled rejection or an upset person on the phone.

6. What is your internet speed, and do you have backup internet or power?



Voice Recording Requirement:



Please send a short voice recording reading the sample script below.



“Hi, this is [your name] calling on behalf of our local family-owned memorial office. I’m not calling with anything urgent. I’m reaching out because we help families with cemetery memorials, headstones, monuments, and memorial planning, and I wanted to see if this is something your family may need help with now or in the future.”



The recording does not need to be perfect. We are mainly listening for clear English, a calm phone voice, and a natural, respectful tone.



Please do not send a generic application. We are looking for someone respectful, clear, dependable, and comfortable speaking with families in a professional way.

title: Senior Amazon Account Manager (US Brand Agency) — Full-Time, Remote
description:
We're a US-based agency that manages Amazon for a portfolio of established health, medical, and wellness brands. We're small, fast, and unusually systematized — we run on documented SOPs, internal tooling, and a tight quality bar. We're growing, and we're looking for one excellent senior operator to own brand accounts and grow into a lead as we scale.



This is not a task-VA role. We want someone who can hold a brand's strategy in their head, make judgment calls without being told what to do, and be trusted with a real P&L. If you've run Amazon agency-side across multiple brands and you're looking for one stable, long-term home rather than a rotating client roster — read on.



What you'll own



Day-to-day management of assigned brand accounts in Seller Central — you are the person responsible for each brand's health, growth, and problems

Listing creation and optimization: titles, bullets, A+ content, flat-file uploads, and catalog troubleshooting (suppressions, variation issues, stranded inventory)

PPC (Sponsored Products / Brands / Display): campaign builds, bid and budget management, search-term harvesting, and hitting ACoS / TACoS targets

Keyword and competitor research using tools like DataDive, Helium 10, or Jungle Scout

Monitoring buybox, pricing, and unauthorized sellers — and flagging issues fast

Weekly reporting with a clear point of view on what's working and what to do next

Working inside our SOP and tooling system — and helping make it better

As we grow: helping QC and lead junior tea
mbers



Who we're looking for (required)



5+ years hands-on Amazon Seller Central management, ideally agency-side across multiple brands (not just one in-house brand)

Real PPC competence — you can explain your bidding logic and point to results you've driven, not just "I've run ads"

Comfortable with flat files and catalog troubleshooting

Strong written English — good enough to write to a brand owner directly

Willing to overlap with US Pacific business hours (we'll discuss specifics, but expect a solid morning-PT overlap for calls and real-time work)

Self-directed. You move things forward without waiting to be told.



Bonus points



Experience in health, medical, supplement, or other regulated categories (you understand why compliance and claims matter)

You've managed or trained other people

You're fluent with AI tools and use them well — but you know not to trust their output blindly

Familiarity with Keepa and reporting/dashboard tools



The details



Full-time, long-term, remote

Schedule: Mon–Fri, significant overlap with US Pacific hours; roughly 7:00am–2:00pm PT

Pay: $2,000–$3,500 USD/month depending on experience.

Growth: this is the first of a growing team. The right person becomes our lead.



How to apply



We read every application that follows these instructions — and we skip every one that doesn't.



Start your message with the word PELICAN so we know you read this far.

In 3–4 sentences, tell us about one specific Amazon problem you solved that you're proud of — what was broken, what you did, and what happened. Be specific; numbers help.

Tell us which Amazon tools you use day-to-day.

Tell us your favorite way to boost ranking (BSR). The more specific you are, the better. 



We move fast for the right person. Shortlisted candidates complete a short paid trial task before any final interview.

title: Senior Full-Stack Developer — SaaS, Meta API, AI Integration (Long-Term, Start ASAP)
description:
We are building a multi-tenant SaaS product in the social-media and ecommerce space and are hiring a senior full-stack developer for a long-term engagement, starting immediately. Initial scope is a 12-week MVP build, with strong preference for the right person to continue as the ongoing technical owner for maintenance, Phase 2 features, and Meta partnership work.



I'm a non-technical founder hiring my first technical lead. I value clear communication, working software, honest answers about what you do and don't know, and someone who will push back when I'm wrong.



This is a senior role. Please don't apply if you are a junior, a generalist, or an agency.



Required experience:

- 4+ years senior full-stack development with production SaaS shipped

- Direct production experience with the Meta Graph API and/or Instagram Graph API — non-negotiable, proof required

- Completed Meta App Review and Business Verification at least once

- Real-time webhook architectures (idempotency, redelivery, retries)

- OAuth 2.0 token lifecycle (encrypted storage, refresh, expiry, reconnect flows)

- Multi-tenant SaaS architecture with strict tenant isolation

- Durable background job queues (Inngest, BullMQ, or equivalent)

- LLM API integration in production (Claude, OpenAI, or similar) — including structured outputs, RAG, and cost control at scale

- Postgres at production scale

- TypeScript / Next.js

- Stripe billing with usage-based metering

- Excellent written and spoken English



Bonus:

- Meta Tech Provider / Business Partner experience

- Shopify or ecommerce platform integrations

- Prior work on moderation, content intelligence, or social analytics products



Engagement terms:

- Long-term contract, full-time hours

- You work during your local business hours, available consistently — no US overlap required

- Aggressive MVP timeline, so steady weekly output matters more than which timezone you sit in

- Milestone-based payments tied to written acceptance criteria

- NDA signed at engagement start (required before any product details are shared)

- Full IP assignment of all code and work product to the client

- Client owns the GitHub repository and all third-party API credentials

- Weekly written status updates and a working demo at the end of each two-week sprint

- A short paid trial task (4–8 hours) before the full engagement begins, so we both confirm fit



Pay: We pay competitively for senior talent. Submit your weekly rate in USD with your application — strong candidates will not be filtered on rate alone.



To apply, send the following in writing:

1. Brief introduction and your weekly rate in USD

2. Years of senior development experience

3. Specific Meta API products you have shipped against (Graph API, Instagram Graph, Messenger, Marketing API) with a one-line description of each project

4. Your Meta App Review experience: which permissions were approved, how long it took, any rejection cycles and how you resolved them

5. One example of a webhook-driven, multi-tenant SaaS you have built, with brief architecture notes

6. How you would approach handling Meta's per-account API rate limits during a viral traffic burst (a few sentences — this is a sanity check)

7. Two references from prior SaaS clients (we will contact them)

8. Portfolio or GitHub link with relevant code samples

9. Your earliest start date and weekly availability



Applications that do not address items 3, 4, 5, and 6 will not be reviewed. We are evaluating multiple candidates this week and will respond to qualifying applicants within 3 business days. Generic copy-paste applications will be ignored.

title: Graphic Designer Needed – Canva Flyer Template Redesign
description:
# Graphic Designer Needed – Canva Flyer Template Redesign



## About the Project



I am looking for a talented graphic designer with strong Canva experience to help modernize and elevate my current flyer templates. My business specializes in Disney pin collecting and sales, and I want a fresh, polished design system that better reflects my brand while remaining highly functional for sharing product information, event details, release schedules, and announcements.



The goal is to create flyer templates that are visually engaging, easy to read, and optimized for social media while maintaining a cohesive brand identity.



## What I'm Looking For



* Strong experience designing in Canva

* Ability to create clean, modern, and visually appealing layouts

* Understanding of social media marketing and attention-grabbing design

* Experience balancing large amounts of information without making designs feel cluttered

* Ability to work within established brand colors and aesthetics

* Creative eye for typography, spacing, hierarchy, and visual flow

* Experience creating reusable templates



## Brand Style



My brand aesthetic is:



* Light pink and maroon color palette

* Soft, welcoming, and elegant feel

* Rounded elements and smooth design transitions

* Subtle Asian-inspired design influences

* Product-focused layouts that showcase pins clearly

* Easy-to-read information hierarchy



I generally prefer softer designs over sharp angles or harsh section breaks.



## Project Scope



The selected designer will:



* Redesign my existing flyer template system

* Create a modern and cohesive visual identity across flyers

* Improve readability and information organization

* Develop layouts that allow for varying amounts of content

* Ensure templates work well for Instagram posts and stories

* Create reusable Canva templates that I can easily update myself



Examples of flyer types include:



* New release announcements

* Presale announcements

* Catalog releases

* Event information

* Product spotlights

* Shop updates

* Community and 
 announcements



## Deliverables



* Fully editable Canva templates

* Brand-consistent design system

* Font recommendations

* Color palette usage guidelines

* Multiple layout variations for different content needs



## Application Process



Candidates who pass the initial screening stage will be asked to complete a short test project based on an existing Great Stone Dragon flyer. This test project is intended to demonstrate your approach to information hierarchy, layout organization, branding, and Canva proficiency.



To confirm that you have read the full listing and are willing to complete the test project if selected, please include the phrase:



**"confirm test project"**



in your application response.



Applications that do not include this phrase may not be considered.



## To Apply



Please include:



* Canva portfolio or relevant design samples

* Examples of social media graphics or promotional flyers

* Brief description of your design process

* Estimated timeline

* Pricing or project quote



Bonus points if you have experience with Disney, collectibles, pin trading, or fandom-related brands.



My goal is to create a flyer system that feels professional, modern, and instantly recognizable while helping important information stand out and drive engagement.

nt it touches real data

title: Fashion Designer & Product Development Specialist
description:
YESUGOD is a luxury Christian fashion and lifestyle brand creating apparel, accessories, and experiences that merge faith, culture, and high-end design. Our pieces are designed to feel elevated, modern, meaningful, and conversation-starting — blending biblical inspiration with luxury fashion aesthetics.



We are looking for a talented Fashion Designer to join our creative team and help bring new YESUGOD collections to life. We are not looking for basic designs. YESUGOD pieces should feel intentional, elevated, and unique. We want someone who can help us create garments that feel luxurious, meaningful, and fresh — pieces that people would want to wear because they look beautiful, but also because they carry a deeper message.



About the Role:

We are seeking a creative, detail-oriented Fashion Designer who understands modern women’s fashion, luxury streetwear, occasionwear, and elevated ready-to-wear. The ideal candidate can take a creative concept and turn it into clear design direction, sketches, technical details, and manufacturer-ready ideas.



You should have a strong eye for silhouettes, fabric, fit, trends, and brand identity. This role is perfect for someone who can balance creativity with commercial appeal and help us design pieces that feel unique, wearable, and true to the YESUGOD brand.



Core Responsibilities:



* Create original fashion concepts for women’s apparel, accessories, and future collections

* Develop sketches, design mockups, and visual design directions

* Create detailed tech packs for manufacturers, including measurements, construction notes, trims, fabric suggestions, and design specifications

* Research current fashion trends, luxury brands, fabrics, silhouettes, and styling direction

* Help refine existing garment samples by identifying fit, proportion, construction, and design improvements

* Suggest fabric types, GSM, finishes, trims, and hardware suitable for each design

* Create mood boards and collection concepts based on YESUGOD’s brand direction

* Work with our team to translate faith-based inspiration into subtle, elevated fashion pieces

* Communicate clearly with manufacturers when design revisions are needed

* Support product development from concept to sample approval



Trend Research & Creative Direction Responsibilities:



* Research current and upcoming fashion trends across luxury womenswear, streetwear, resortwear, occasionwear, accessories, and Christian/lifestyle fashion

* Study relevant brands, influencer styling, retail bestsellers, and emerging design details to inform YESUGOD collections

* Create mood boards, trend reports, silhouette references, fabric direction, color palettes, and styling concepts

* Identify commercially strong product opportunities that align with YESUGOD’s brand identity and customer base

* Translate trend research into original YESUGOD designs rather than copying existing brands

* Monitor what is selling in the market, including silhouettes, fabrics, colors, embellishments, fit preferences, and styling direction

* Present clear creative recommendations for upcoming drops, seasonal collections, and hero pieces



Ideal Candidate:



* Has experience in fashion design, technical design, or apparel product development

* Can create professional tech packs and clear design specifications

* Understands women’s fashion, luxury streetwear, elevated basics, occasionwear, and statement pieces

* Has a strong eye for fit, proportion, and garment construction

* Understands fabrics, trims, seams, stitching, lining, closures, and production details

* Can design pieces that are unique but still wearable and commercially appealing

* Is detail-oriented, responsive, organized, and able to meet deadlines

* Can work independently and take creative direction well

* Has strong English communication skills



Required Skills:



* Fashion sketching or digital fashion illustration

* Tech pack creation

* Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop, Canva, Procreate, CLO3D, or similar design tools

* Fabric and garment construction knowledge

* Trend research and mood board creation

* Strong written communication



Bonus Skills:



* Experience working with overseas manufacturers

* Experience designing for e-commerce fashion brands

* Experience with luxury women’s apparel, dresses, outerwear, bags, or accessories

* Experience creating 3D garment mockups or AI-assisted fashion concepts

* Knowledge of Christian fashion, modest fashion, or faith-based branding



To Apply: 



Please send the following:

1. Your portfolio or examples of previous fashion design work

2. Examples of tech packs you have created, if available

3. Your experience with women’s apparel, accessories, or luxury-inspired fashion

4. A short explanation of why you would be a good fit



Applications without a portfolio or sample work may not be considered. Please only apply if you have experience creating original fashion concepts, trend research, and manufacturer-ready tech packs for apparel or accessories.

title: # GHL & N8N Developer (Flexible Hours)
description:
# GHL & N8N Developer - Video Documentation Required (Flexible Hours)



## Job Overview

**Rate:** $?/hour

**Hours:** Flexible 5-40 hours per week (average 15-25 hours)

I am looking for a **self-motivated developer** who can build GoHighLevel (GHL) workflows with N8N integrations. This is a long-term position with lots of ongoing work.



---



## Important: How We Work Together



**This position requires video recording of all work.** Here is why:



We will work on the same projects together, but at different times:

1. You complete some work on the project

2. I continue working on the project

3. You come back and complete more work

4. I continue working again



**Because we both work on the same projects, you MUST record video (with audio explanation) for every billable hour.** This helps me understand:

- What you built

- How you built it

- Why you made specific decisions

- How to continue the work when you are not available



**This is a requirement for every hour billed. If you cannot record your work with explanations, this job is not a good fit.**



---



## What You Will Build



**Main Projects:**

- GoHighLevel workflows (advanced automation)

- N8N integrations that connect with GHL

- Lead generation systems

- Database reactivation campaigns

- Troubleshooting and improving existing automations



**Additional Projects:**

- Simple CRM setup

- Website development

- Other automation and integration tasks



**There is a large amount of work available.** If you want consistent income and are willing to work hard, this opportunity is for you.



---



## Work Schedule - READ CAREFULLY



**Hours change each week:**

- Slow weeks: 5 hours

- Busy weeks: 40 hours

- Typical weeks: 15-25 hours



**You must be comfortable with changing hours.** Some weeks have more work, some weeks have less work. This is normal for this position.



---



## Required Skills & Qualities



**You must have:**

- Strong experience with GoHighLevel platform

- Strong experience with N8N automation

- Ability to work independently without constant supervision

- Ability to solve problems on your own

- Good communication skills in English (written and spoken)

- Comfortable explaining technical work in simple words

- Comfortable recording video of your work with audio explanation



**Extra skills (helpful but not required):**

- Experience with lead generation in USA consumer markets

- Experience with database reactivation campaigns



---



## What Makes This Job Different



**Independence + Teaching:**

You will work independently most of the time. However, sometimes I will ask questions to learn from you:

- "Why did you connect this in this way?"

- "What is the reason for this step?"

- "Is there a different way to do this?"



You should be comfortable teaching me and explaining your decisions.



**Video Documentation:**

For every hour you bill, you must create a Loom video (or similar screen recording) showing:

- Your screen while you work

- Your voice explaining what you are doing

- Your reasons for making decisions

- How the system works



This is NOT optional. This is required for every billable hour.



---



## How To Apply - VIDEO REQUIRED



**You MUST submit a Loom video (5-10 minutes) that shows:**



1. **Screen recording** of a GHL workflow you created that uses N8N integration

2. **Your voice** explaining:

- What business problem does this workflow solve?

- Why did you build it this way?

- How do GHL and N8N work together in this workflow?

- What decisions did you make and why?



**The video must show:**

- Your ability to explain technical work in clear, simple English

- Your screen while you walk through the workflow

- Your thinking process and decision-making



**Applications without this video will be rejected immediately.**



---



## Also Include In Your Application



1. **Summary of your experience:**

- How long have you used GoHighLevel?

- How long have you used N8N?

- What types of projects have you built?



2. **Lead generation experience (if you have it):**

- Have you built lead generation systems?

- Have you worked with USA consumer markets?



3. **Confirm you understand:**

- Hours change week to week (5-40 hours)

- Video recording with explanation is required for ALL billable hours

- We will both work on the same projects at different times



---



## Next Steps



If you are hardworking, self-motivated, and ready for consistent long-term work, please apply with:
