Phase 1B — College Counseling MVP

The core college counseling workflow layer — what counselors actually use daily.



    • College list and application tracker

    • Essay tracker — Google Docs linking, submission status, word count, deadline tracking

    • Google Drive integration — browse, attach, and share Drive files for all user roles

    • Google Docs integration — link, embed, and collaborate on Docs within the platform

    • Google Calendar sync for counselor session scheduling

    • Meeting notes and session summaries

    • Resource library — counselor uploads (including Google Drive files), student/parent access

    • Public SaaS marketing/landing page with sign-up and free trial flow

    • REST API foundation for external site integration



Phase 1C — Data & Aid Foundation

Initial data and financial planning layer. Scoped to MVP — not the full engine.



    • Basic college database — College Scorecard + IPEDS imported to local database

    • Basic college search and filter interface

    • Basic parent financial profile intake

    • SAI estimator using current federal formula

    • Persistent disclaimer layer on all financial output screens



Phase 2 — College Career Pathways Website

    • Rebuilt 
 — modern, responsive, SEO-optimized

    • All marketing and booking pages

    • Calendly scheduling integration

    • Stripe payment integration for session bookings

    •
 notification system

    • API integration with SaaS platform for seamless branded portal

    • Client login routing to 



Phase 3 — College Database & Financial Aid Engine

    • College Scorecard + IPEDS data import, synced to local database with periodic refresh

    • College database — College Scorecard + IPEDS/NCES data imported to local database with periodic refresh

    • Searchable, filterable college database with profile pages

, or Fastweb for post-MVP enrichment

All Phases — Standard Requirements

    • All source code in a private GitHub repository — client retains full ownership of all code and IP

    • Admin guide — onboarding counselors, managing subscriptions, adding features

    • Basic testing and QA

Requirements

Must Have

    • 3+ years building full-stack web applications

    • Proven experience building multi-tenant SaaS applications

    • Non-negotiable — show a live example in your application

    • Strong Next.js / React skills or equivalent

    • PostgreSQL and Supabase or equivalent experience

    • Stripe Billing — subscriptions, webhooks, plan limits

    • Role-based access control and secure authentication

    • API design and REST endpoint development

    • Secure file upload and storage (S3 or equivalent)

    • Strong understanding of tenant data isolation

    • Mobile-first design — full portal functionality on mobile browser (iOS Safari, Android Chrome) with no app required

    • Touch-friendly navigation, tap-sized buttons, fast load times, forms that work on mobile keyboards

    • This is a hard requirement — parents and students will primarily access the portal on phones

    • Ability to work directly with a non-technical founder and product owner

    • Ability to think through product architecture, not just execute tickets

    • Strong English communication



Nice to Have

    • Experience as a technical lead or fractional CTO

    • Experience building SaaS dashboards and client portals

    • Experience with edtech, CRM systems, or financial planning tools

    • Experience consuming and syncing large government or third-party data APIs — College Scorecard, IPEDS, or similar

    • Experience building search/filter UIs against large locally synced datasets

    • Familiarity with FAFSA/SAI formula, EFC, or financial aid calculation methodologies

    • Experience building scholarship rules engines or matching tools; experience with 
, Fastweb, Going Merry, or similar a plus

    • White-label SaaS and custom domain/subdomain experience

    • UI/UX design skills (Figma)

    • 
 or Calendly integration experience

    • n8n, Pipedream, 
v, or Inngest experience

    • PostHog, Sentry, or similar observability tools





How to Apply

Incomplete applications will not be reviewed.



Please Send

1.  Portfolio or GitHub profile

2.  At least one example of a multi-tenant SaaS or subscription application you built — live link, screenshots, or Loom walkthrough

3.  Your proposed tech stack and architecture approach for this project

4.  Your recommended Phase 0 discovery process and what it would include

5.  Your estimated timeline for Phase 0, Phase 1A, Phase 1B, Phase 1C, Phase 2, and Phase 3 separately

6.  Your rate —, fixed-price, milestone-based

7.  Your availability and preferred working hours

8.  A short paragraph explaining why this project is a fit for you



Please Also Answer These Questions

Answers do not need to be long, but they must be specific. Generic answers will be disqualified.



1.  Have you built a multi-tenant SaaS product before? Describe the product, how you isolated tenant data, and what stack you used.

2.  How would you isolate each counselor/practice tenant's data — RLS, separate schemas, separate databases, or another approach? Why?

3.  How would you handle the platform owner, counselor, staff, student, and parent roles and prevent cross-tenant or cross-student data access?

4.  How would you implement secure document uploads — storage, access control, download URLs, and audit logging?

5.  How would you structure Stripe subscriptions, plan limits, failed payment handling, and the customer billing portal?

6.  How would you build white-label branded portals and custom subdomains per counseling business?

7.  How would you design the API so the College Career Pathways website can authenticate against and consume data from the SaaS platform?

8.  Which college data sources would you use — College Scorecard, IPEDS, Common Data Set, Peterson's, or a combination? How would you handle average GPA given it is not consistently available in federal datasets?

9.  How would you implement the SAI/FAFSA estimator using the post-2024 federal formula? What data sources would you use for per-school net price estimation?

10.  Which scholarship data sources would you recommend for the rules engine — Going Merry, 
, Fastweb, manually curated college merit aid, or another approach? What are the licensing terms and integration complexity for your recommended option?

11.  What would you build in MVP versus later phases, and why?

12.  How would you avoid a Zapier dependency for core workflows?

13.  How would you implement Google Drive and Google Docs integration for all user types — counselors, students, and parents? How would you handle OAuth scoping, file permissions, and the choice between storing Drive links vs. importing files into platform storage?

14.  What are the biggest technical risks you see in this project, and how would you mitigate them?

15.  How would you ensure the student and parent portal works fully on mobile browsers (iOS Safari, Android Chrome) without requiring an app download? What specific mobile UX considerations would you build in from day one?





Budget & Working Style

We are open to proposals. We understand this is a real SaaS product with real complexity and are prepared to pay fairly for the right person.



Please provide estimates for:

    • Phase 0 — Discovery and architecture sprint

    • Phase 1A — Core SaaS foundation

    • Phase 1B — College counseling MVP

    • Phase 1C — Data and aid foundation

    • Phase 2 — College Career Pathways website

    • Phase 3 — College database and financial aid engine



    



We prefer to begin with a paid discovery sprint before committing to the full build. After discovery, we are open to:

    • Fixed-price milestones

    • Long-term monthly retainer after launch



We are looking for a technical partner, not a one-time contractor.



This is a long-term opportunity.

We are building a real SaaS business with a real first customer already lined up.

College Career Pathways will be the first live customer and proof of concept. After the MVP is stable, we plan to invite additional counselors as beta users and grow the platform into a subscription product.

The right developer becomes our ongoing technical partner as the platform grows, new features ship, and more counselors subscribe.

title: Elite Real Estate Photo Editor
description:
# Elite Real Estate Photo Editor



**Salary: $1,386 – $1,733 USD / month (Average) ($8–$10 USD per hour) (Biweekly pay)**



**Allard Media Group** is a fast-growing real estate media company based in **Newton, MA, USA**.



We produce premium real estate photography for top-performing agents, and we're hiring one world-class photo editor to help maintain the quality our clients expect.



We are **NOT** looking for someone who simply runs HDR software. We are looking for someone with an exceptional eye for detail and consistency.



## What You'll Do



* Edit high-end HDR real estate photography

* Blend exposures naturally while maintaining realistic lighting

* Correct color, white balance, perspective, and verticals

* Remove minor distractions and deliver polished, MLS-ready images

* Maintain consistency across every property

* Communicate clearly and meet fast turnaround times



## Requirements (Non-Negotiable)



* Elite-level real estate photo editing ability

* Extensive experience editing HDR real estate photography

* Strong understanding of composition, perspective correction, color accuracy, and natural-looking edits

* Experience with Lightroom and Photoshop (or equivalent professional software)

* Reliable high-speed internet with backup internet and power

* Excellent communication and quick responses during your shift

* Flexible schedule with significant overlap during U.S. Eastern business hours

* Desire to grow long-term with a fast-growing U.S. media company



## To Apply



Please include:



1. A link to your **best** real estate photography portfolio or before-and-after edits

2. Use **8 Apply Points**

3. Include the word **"Elite2"** in your application



---



For the right editor, this is more than just another editing job.



We're looking for someone who cares about quality, consistency, and becoming an important part of a growing creative team.



If you're truly elite, we'd love to hear from you.



---



## About Us



Allard Media Group is a professional real estate media company based in Newton, Massachusetts, serving agents throughout New England. We specialize in premium real estate photography, video, floor plans, aerial media, and marketing content. Our team is growing quickly, and we're looking for talented people who are committed to producing outstanding work for years to come.

title: Director of Talent Acquisition and People Operations
description:
Urgent Hiring — Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis. The selection process may take up to 4 weeks, but early applicants are strongly encouraged.



Ready to Empower a Growing Team and Shape Our Future?



At Hadley Designs, we believe that learning should be enjoyable, engaging, and screen-free. Millions of parents and teachers trust our beautifully designed, developmentally aligned educational tools to help children grow and thrive. As a fast-growing, family-founded brand, we are on a mission to make learning meaningful for families around the world.

We are seeking a Director of People Operations to join our team and build the systems that will drive our next phase of growth. If you are passionate about creating scalable people systems, empowering teams, and cultivating a culture that supports both personal and professional growth, this role offers a unique opportunity to make a significant impact.



About Hadley Designs

Hadley Designs is redefining early education with creativity and purpose. Every product we create is hand-drawn and teacher-designed, crafted with care to build confidence and connection. Our screen-free tools help families and teachers make learning fun and meaningful, nurturing curiosity and creativity in children.



Our Mission:



We design screen-free products that parents can trust to help their children learn, grow, and reach their full potential. We create beautifully designed, developmentally sound tools that replace noise and distraction with connection, curiosity, and real learning.



Our Vision:



We aim to build the most trusted children’s brand in the world, present in millions of homes, reshaping how families learn, connect, and grow. Our products will be so widely used and passed down that generations of children will grow up learning from them and choose them again for their own families.



Role Overview



As the Director of Talent Acquisition & People Operations, you will own how Hadley Designs sources, vets, and closes top global talent, and you will own the broader people system that talent steps into. You will partner with leadership to design the recruiting engine that consistently delivers strong top-of-funnel for every open role, and you will scale the people systems that hold a remote, contractor-centric organization together as it grows toward $100M and beyond.



This is a leadership-tier role with 1 direct report (the People Operations Specialist) and end-to-end ownership of the talent and people functions. Your weeks will be heavier on recruiting in the near term, live pipelines, structured interviews, test projects, employer brand, and steady on People Operations throughout (onboarding, performance frameworks, contractor renewal, leadership enablement).



Key Responsibilities



Talent Acquisition (the #1 outcome of this role):

• Recruiting Pipeline Management: Source candidates across LinkedIn, job boards, freelancer platforms, and referrals; filter applicants for red flags, competency match, and scorecard alignment.

• Test Project & Interview Operations: Run test projects, review submissions, conduct first-round group interviews, and manage candidate experience end-to-end.

title: Chief People Officer
description:

At Hadley Designs, we believe that learning should be enjoyable, engaging, and screen-free. Millions of parents and teachers trust our beautifully designed, developmentally aligned educational tools to help children grow and thrive. As a fast-growing, family-founded brand, we are on a mission to make learning meaningful for families around the world.

We are seeking a Chief People Officer to join our team and build the systems that will drive our next phase of growth. If you are passionate about creating scalable people systems, empowering teams, and cultivating a culture that supports both personal and professional growth, this role offers a unique opportunity to make a significant impact.



About Hadley Designs

- Improved leadership confidence in people systems, talent readiness, and organizational alignment. 

- Predictable, scalable people operations that contribute to the company’s growth and success.



Who You Are



You are a strategic, results-driven leader with a passion for creating systems that empower teams and enable sustainable growth. You thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and have a track record of building effective people systems in alignment with business goals.



You Have:

- 5+ years of experience in People Operations, HR leadership, or a related field, ideally in a fast-growing environment.

- Proven ability to build scalable systems that attract, develop, and retain talent.

- A growth mindset and a collaborative approach to solving problems. 

- Experience using data to drive decisions and measure success.



Why You’ll Love Working Here

- Culture: Join a passionate, mission-driven team that values trust, creativity, and collaboration. 

- Flexibility: Enjoy the freedom of a remote role with flexible working hours.

title: Video Editor, Long-Term Role with US Marketing Agency (Starts Part-Time, Can Go Full-Time)
description:
Starts part-time. You can stay part-time, or move to full-time after 30 days if you're a good fit.



Read the whole thing before you apply.



The most important skill is Premiere Pro. You must be able to sit down, open a project, and edit. If you're at that level in DaVinci Resolve or a similar studio-quality video platform, that can work too. Talking-head experience is a nice bonus, but honestly, as long as you're fluent in Premiere, that's what matters.



How the work goes

This is mostly short-form video editing, with some long-form too, mainly talking-head videos. You'll edit in Premiere, and we use a few other tools like Submagic and CapCut along the way. None of it is hard to pick up.



You won't be on an island. We're a small team spread across the globe, and you'll work with them day to day. So you've got to work well with a team, and be able to run on your own when you need to.



Your English has to be excellent. We all come from different places, but English is how we connect. If we can't communicate easily, the whole process breaks down. That's the whole reason I ask for the Loom video below. I just want to hear you speak.



The money

This starts part-time, 20 hours a week.

To start: $350 per month

After your 30-day trial: $400 per month

After two more months: $500 per month



After that: regular reviews, with raises based on how you grow and the value you bring.



You won't get a raise every month. The first few bumps just get you up to pay that feels good. Then it settles into regular reviews. Pay comes every two weeks, in USD, on time, every time.



HOW TO APPLY

Two things. Skip either one and I'll delete your application without reading it.

1. Put "peanut butter" in the subject line. That tells me you actually read this.

2. Send me a one-minute Loom video. Talk about anything: your background, your experience, whatever. This is non-negotiable.



That's it. No agencies, individuals only. I'm hiring one person, and I'm hiring fast, so show me who you are.

title: Staff Security Engineer
description:
OVERVIEW 



The number one goal of everyone on our team is to deliver an exceptional service and experience to our clients. The Staff Security Engineer plays a critical role in achieving that by leading the technical security work that keeps our clients protected, and proving that protection every day. 



This is the most senior individual-contributor role on the security team. The Staff Security Engineer sets technical direction for detection, response, and hardening, builds and tunes the tooling our SOC relies on, and leads investigations when something serious happens. 



We believe identity is the first line of defense, and this role owns much of that thesis in practice: strong detections, fast response, and continuous hardening across identity, endpoint, network, and
. 



Beyond hands-on engineering, this role mentors junior SOC analysts, develops the procedures the team runs on, and supports the compliance and reporting work that demonstrates security value to clients and auditors. 



RESPONSIBILITIES & TASKS



DETECTION & SECURITY ENGINEERING

- Build, tune, and maintain detections across the security stack to catch real threats and reduce noise

- Own the configuration and health of SOC tooling spanning EDR, application control, endpoint hardening, identity, and network security

- Develop and maintain detection logic, alerting rules, and automated response actions

- Lead threat hunting across client environments to find what automated detections miss

- Drive continuous hardening across identity (Okta, Beyond Identity, Entra ID), endpoint (CrowdStrike, ThreatLocker, Senteon), and network (Cato Networks, FortiGate, Island Enterprise Browser)



I
 RESPONSE

- Serve as the senior technical lead during security i
 and investigations

- Lead containment, eradication, and recovery for confirmed compromises

- Conduct root-cause analysis and produce clear post-i
 findings

- Translate i
 lessons into improved detections and procedures



VULNERABILITY & POSTURE MANAGEMENT

- Lead the vulnerability management program: scanning, prioritization, and remediation tracking

- Assess client environments against recognized frameworks (NIST, CIS) and identify gaps

 - Leverage GRC tooling (Vanta, Drata) to track posture, manage evidence, and support compliance programs

- Recommend and help implement security improvements that measurably reduce risk



SOC PROCEDURES & DOCUMENTATION

- Develop and maintain SOC runbooks and investigation procedures

- Document detections, response steps, and tooling configuration in the team's documentation systems

- Ensure all investigations and actions are accurately tracked in Pylon

- Build repeatable, teachable processes so the team responds consistently



COMPLIANCE & REPORTING

Support compliance and evidence work using Vanta and Drata (frameworks, attestations, cyber insurance requirements)

Contribute security data and narrative to client reporting and business reviews

Help translate technical security posture into business-level risk language



COMMUNICATION, REPORTING & RISK MANAGEMENT

- Identify and proactively communicate security risks and gaps

- Escalate significant findings and i
 to the CISO / vCISO

- Provide clear updates during active investigations

- Ensure alignment between security work and client risk priorities



TEAMWORK & LEADERSHIP

- Mentor and coach junior SOC analysts on investigation and detection skills

- Set the technical standard for quality and rigor on the security team

- Follow and contribute to Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs)

- Contribute to innovation and continuous improvement initiatives



SKILLS AND ATTRIBUTES



REQUIRED

- Strong hands-on experience in security operations, detection engineering, or i
 respons

- Deep identity security experience: Okta, Beyond Identity, Entra ID, Conditional Access, token and session attack patterns

- Hands-on experience with enterprise EDR (CrowdStrike or equivalent) and endpoint investigation

- Experience with application control and endpoint hardening (ThreatLocker, Senteon, or equivalent)

- Working knowledge of SASE/SD-WAN and network security tooling (Cato Networks, FortiGate)

- Multi-platform device management experience (NinjaOne, Addigy, Intune, Apple Business Manager

- Experience with GRC and compliance platforms (Vanta, Drata, or equivalent)

- I
 response experience across identity, endpoint, and network

- Vulnerability management and hardening experience

- Working knowledge of frameworks such as NIST CSF and CIS Controls

- Scripting and automation experience (PowerShell preferred)

- Excellent communication skills, including writing clear findings for non-technical audiences

- A deep desire to deliver an exceptional client experience



NICE TO HAVE

- Experience working in a Managed Service Provider (MSP) or MSSP environment

- Hands-on experience with tools in our stack (CrowdStrike Flight Control, ThreatLocker, Senteon, Okta, Beyond Identity, Cato - Networks, Island Enterprise Browser, Vanta, Drata)

- Certifications such as:

  - Security (Security+, CySA+, GCIH, GCIA, or equivalent)

title: Refunds and Replacements Officer

This is a long-term remote position ideal for someone who is confident communicating with clients and collaborating with internal teams. The role requires excellent communication skills and the ability to work during UK business hours.



Job Overview

We are seeking a detail-oriented and customer-focused Refunds & Replacements Officer to manage customer requests relating to refunds, returns, replacements, and order disputes. The successful candidate will ensure all cases are handled accurately, fairly, and in accordance with company policies while maintaining a positive customer experience.



This role requires strong problem-solving skills, excellent attention to detail, and the ability to work efficiently in a fast-paced e-commerce environment.



Key Responsibilities

1. Refund Management

• Review and process customer refund requests in line with company policies

• Verify eligibility for refunds by reviewing order details, delivery information, and supporting evidence

• Process approved refunds through the appropriate payment channels

• Maintain accurate records of all refund transactions



2. Replacement Management

• Assess and process product replacement requests

• Coordinate with warehouse and logistics teams to arrange replacement shipments

• Verify damaged, defective, incorrect, or missing item claims

• Ensure replacement orders are dispatched within agreed service levels



3. Investigation & Resolution

• Investigate customer complaints relating to deliveries, damaged products, missing items, and incorrect orders

• Gather and evaluate supporting evidence such as photographs, courier tracking updates, and customer communications

• Identify fraudulent or suspicious claims and escalate when necessary

• Make informed decisions based on company policies and available evidence



4. Customer Communication

• Respond to customers via
, live chat, and ticketing systems

• Provide clear explanations regarding refund and replacement decisions

• Request additional information when required

• Deliver professional and empathetic customer service throughout the resolution process



5. Reporting & Administration

• Maintain detailed case notes and documentation

• Monitor refund and replacement trends

• Prepare regular reports on refund rates, replacement cases, and claim outcomes

• Recommend process improvements to reduce customer issues and financial losses



Requirements

1. Essential

• Previous experience in customer service, e-commerce operations, claims handling, or dispute resolution

• Strong written and verbal communication skills

• Excellent attention to detail and analytical thinking

• Ability to review evidence and make objective decisions

• Strong organizational and time management skills

• Proficiency in Google Workspace and Microsoft Office applications

• Ability to work independently and manage multiple cases simultaneously



2. Preferred

• Experience with Shopify, Zendesk, Zoho, or similar customer support platforms

• Experience handling refunds, chargebacks, returns, or warranty claims

• Familiarity with courier tracking systems and logistics processes

• Experience working in an e-commerce or retail environment



Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

• Refund processing accuracy

• Replacement processing turnaround time

• Case resolution time

• Policy compliance rate

• Reduction in fraudulent or invalid claims

• Documentation accuracy



What We Offer

• Remote work environment

• Ongoing training and development opportunities

• Supportive team culture

• Career growth opportunities

• Competitive compensation package



Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is highly organized, fair, investigative by nature, and capable of balancing customer satisfaction with company policy. They are comfortable making evidence-based decisions and can confidently handle sensitive customer situations while maintaining professionalism.

title: Finance Operations Coordinator (Accountant)
description:
About the role

We’re a US-based commercial facilities and cleaning company in the Los Angeles area, operating on a subcontractor model. We’re looking for a sharp, reliable Finance & Operations Coordinator to own our billing, accounting, and financial operations end-to-end. This is a LONG-TERM role — we want someone who grows with us, not a short gig.

You’ll work primarily in Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central (our main platform for billing, invoicing, and financial operations) and QuickBooks Online (our expense and cost-tracking system). Business Central fluency or a strong ERP background is important. QuickBooks experience is required.

The hours are variable by design — lighter mid-month, heavier around billing week (the 1st) and close week (the 10th). This is not a flat 20-hours-every-week role. If you want steady, predictable hours, this isn’t the right fit. If you want a role where your work directly matters and you can grow into a senior position, keep reading.

What you’ll own

BILLING & INVOICING

• Run consolidated billing monthly and process ongoing project invoices daily in Business Central

• Process OS (one
 project) invoices — both batch and individual

• Generate and send customer statements — batch and individual

• Set up new customers in BC: net terms,
 addresses, dimensions, address validation



INDEPENDENT CONTRACTOR OPERATIONS

• Generate and post IC (subcontractor) pay in Business Central by the 6th of each month

• Manage performance deposit tracking: check balances and account orientation

• Follow up on IC insurance compliance gaps



ACCOUNTING & CLOSE

• Run month-end close — hard deadline the 10th of each month, no exceptions

• Process payroll postings: generate Gusto reports, create import template, post to Business Central

• Record Avalara sales tax entries

• Manage loan entries: creating loans and posting interest expenses

• Run standard reports: consolidated billing report, CRM contract/IC report



QUICKBOOKS BOOKKEEPING

• Categorize expense transactions in QuickBooks Online: code vendor bills, credit card charges, and bank transactions to the correct chart of accounts

• Reconcile balance sheet accounts in QuickBooks monthly: bank accounts, credit cards, and key liability accounts must be cleared and tied out before close

• Enter journal entries into Business Central from QuickBooks data: translate QB expense totals and accruals into BC journal lines as part of the monthly close package



ACCOUNTS RECEIVABLE

• Follow up with customers on overdue balances and escalate appropriately

• Submit invoices to customer-specific vendor portals and billing systems

• Complete vendor onboarding for new customers



SUPPLIES & ADMIN

• Manage supplies orders: check inventory, process orders, send confirmations

• Handle contract management in Business Central: manual edits and modifications



Must have

• 3+ years of accounting or finance operations experience supporting US-based businesses

• Strong QuickBooks Online skills: bank reconciliation, journal entries, AP/AR, expense categorization

• Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central experience OR strong ERP experience (NetSuite, SAP, Xero) with demonstrated ability to learn new systems quickly

• Solid understanding of accrual-basis accounting and month-end close

• Exceptional attention to detail — you catch things that others miss and you flag them without being asked

• Reliable, deadline-driven: the 10th-of-month close is non-negotiable

• Strong written English for customer-facing AR work and vendor communications

• Comfortable with variable, peak-and-valley workload around billing and close weeks



Nice to have

• Direct Business Central experience: customer cards, invoice batching, IC pay, contract management

• Experience with Avalara or other sales tax platforms

• Experience with Gusto payroll

• Background supporting service businesses, franchises, or subcontractor-based operations



The growth path

This is not a bookkeeping job long-term. The trajectory for the right person: own the billing and close operations ? manage a part-time bookkeeper below you ? grow into a finance and operations partner to the owner. If you want to build something, not just process transactions, this is the role.



How to apply

Please include ALL of the following or your application will not be considered:

• A short description of your Business Central and QuickBooks experience — specifically what you’ve done in each system

• Your expected hourly rate (USD)

• Your typical available hours in US Pacific Time

• Your DISC and IQ scores from your OnlineJobs.ph profile

• Answer to this question: We receive a franchise invoice on the 20th of each month for fees that relate to the prior month (royalty, marketing fund, tech fee). Our books close on the 10th. How would you handle recording these fees, and what accounts would you use?

title: CPG Product Development Manager | URGENT
description:
Location: Remote (Los Angeles, CA based company) | Type: Full-Time | Experience: 5–10 Years



About the Role:



We're looking for a driven and detail-oriented Product Development Manager with prior experience in CPG, food & beverage, pet, beauty, or consumer packaged goods manufacturing. You'll join our team and serve as the central engine behind new products, product modifications, new size launches, a packaging overhaul and product line management across our portfolio of brands. This is a cross-functional role that sits at the intersection of product, sourcing, and brand — and the right person thrives in both strategic and hands-on environments.



You'll partner closely with our brand teams, business managers, and procurement specialist to take product changes from concept to completion. You'll own the full lifecycle of each project and keep all the moving parts aligned.



What You'll Do:



Product Development & Modification



Lead and execute new products OR product changes across multiple brands — including new sizes, format changes, material updates, modifications, and dimension adjustments

Translate brand and business team requests into clear, actionable product specifications

Proactively identify opportunities for product line extensions or improvements across the portfolio

Review and approve spec sheets, prototypes, and samples to ensure they meet brand and quality standards

Portfolio Knowledge & Product Consistency



Maintain a deep, working knowledge of the full product catalog across brands — understanding what exists, what is in development, and how products relate to each other across sizes and variants

Proactively identify and resolve inconsistencies across the portfolio — for example, if one size of a product carries a benefit or feature that another size does not, you flag it and drive alignment

Audit product lines for discrepancies in specs, sizing, materials,, or benefit claims and develop a plan to bring them into consistency

Partner with project managers and growth managers who own the catalog to ensure product development decisions are grounded in the full picture of what exists

Maintain organized records of product specs, supplier details, and project timelines to support cross-team visibility

Supplier & Procurement Collaboration



Work alongside our procurement specialist to source and qualify suppliers based on product requirements

Hand off supplier relationships once specifications are finalized, while staying engaged through launch to ensure alignment

Evaluate supplier capabilities against technical and brand requirements

Cross-Brand Coordination



Act as the central point of contact between brand teams, business managers, procurement, and operations

Manage multiple projects simultaneously across brands without letting anything fall through the cracks

Communicate project status, timelines, risks, and decisions clearly to all stakeholders

Sometimes you'll lead a project from scratch — other times you'll be handed a request and execute it. You're equally comfortable with both.

What We're Looking For:



Experience & Background



5–10 years of experience in product development, product management, or a closely related role

Background in CPG, food & beverage, pet, beauty, or consumer packaged goods manufacturing

Proven track record managing product changes across multiple brands or product lines simultaneously

Experience working with suppliers and cross-functional teams in a fast-paced environment

Skills & Abilities



Technically literate — you can read a spec sheet, understand materials and tolerances, and speak the language of consumer goods manufacturing

Hands-on experience with packaging development — dimensions, materials, structural specs, and print specs are not foreign to you

Strong project management skills — you keep projects on track without micromanaging

Excellent communicator across all levels, from the factory floor to brand leadership

Highly organized with strong attention to detail, especially when managing a large catalog of SKUs

Self-starter who can identify what needs to be done without being told, but also executes well when given direction

Comfortable with ambiguity — you can figure things out as you go

Nice to Have



Prior experience supporting or working within a procurement function

Experience managing private label or multi-brand portfolios

Who You'll Work With



You'll be embedded in a collaborative environment where you interact daily with brand teams, business managers, and our procurement specialist. You won't have direct reports in this role — but you'll have significant influence across the organization. The right person for this role leads through expertise, relationships, and results.



We are an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.





Application Question(s):

Do you have experience developing or commercializing physical consumer products — such as food, beverage, pet, beauty, or household goods? Yes / No

Have you managed product development across more than one brand or product line at the same time? Yes / No

Are you able to communicate professionally in English, both written and verbal? Our team operates globally and all cross-functional communication is conducted in English.

title: Amazon A+ Graphics Designer
description:
Role Overview

We are looking for an experienced Amazon A+ Graphics Designer who knows the Amazon platform inside and out. This is not a general graphic design role. The ideal candidate is a visual expert who understands the Amazon content ecosystem, can navigate Seller Central and Vendor Central confidently, and can identify and fix errors in existing A+ content without hand-holding.



You will own the end-to-end production of Amazon creative assets, from A+ Content and product images to Brand Store design and catalog hygiene, across multiple client accounts in the TaskOn pod model.



Position Details

Role: Amazon A+ Graphics Designer

Employment Type: Full-Time, Remote

Experience Required: 2 to 3 years minimum in Amazon-specific graphic design

Primary Tools: Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign

Supplemental Tools: Canva (secondary use only)

Platform Knowledge: Amazon Seller Central and/or Vendor Central required



What We Are Looking For

Beyond technical skill, we are looking for someone who:

• Takes ownership and works independently without needing platform guidance or task-level supervision

• Has a sharp eye for detail and naturally catches errors, inconsistencies, and compliance issues before they become problems

• Is comfortable managing multiple client accounts simultaneously without letting quality slip

• Approaches Amazon content with a conversion mindset, not just an aesthetic one

• Communicates clearly when flagging issues and follows through without being followed up on

• Treats catalog hygiene and asset organization as part of the job, not an afterthought



Key Responsibilities

A+ Content Design and Production

• Design Basic and Premium A+ Content modules that meet Amazon specifications and conversion goals

• Build comparison charts, feature callouts, sizing guides, and lifestyle layouts tailored to each product category

• Optimize all modules for both mobile and desktop display

• Apply and maintain brand consistency across all creative for each client account

• Refresh and update existing A+ Content based on performance feedback, catalog changes, or brand updates



Content Audit and Error Detection

• Review existing A+ Content across client catalogs and flag issues: broken image links, outdated messaging, non-compliant modules, or formatting errors

• Identify A+ Content that has been suppressed or rejected and diagnose the root cause

• Proactively flag listings that are missing A+ Content or where content quality does not meet brand standards

• Document audit findings and prioritize updates based on traffic and revenue impact



Product Images

• Design main images that comply with Amazon standards (white background, product fills 85% of frame, correct resolution and file size)

• Create supplementary infographic images that highlight key product features, dimensions, and use cases

• Develop hero images and lifestyle compositions that improve click-through rate

• Perform post-production editing including background removal, color correction, and retouching



Brand Store Design and Maintenance

• Build and maintain Amazon Brand Stores using the Brand Store builder in Seller Central or Vendor Central

• Design store layouts that reflect brand identity while following Amazon's store guidelines

• Update store pages for seasonal campaigns, new product launches, or brand refreshes

• Ensure store pages are structured for discoverability and conversion



Catalog and Asset Management

• Upload and manage creative assets directly in Seller Central or Vendor Central

• Maintain organized asset libraries by client, ASIN, and content type

• Track module versions and keep a clear record of what is live on each listing

• Coordinate with the operations team to align design timelines with launch schedules



Advertising Creative Support

• Design Sponsored Brands banners, custom image ads, and Sponsored Display creatives

• Create video ad thumbnails and end cards as needed

• Align advertising creative with the visual language established in A+ Content and Brand Store assets



Tools and Platform

Primary design tools:

• Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, and InDesign



Amazon platform (must navigate independently):

• Seller Central: A+ Content Manager, Brand Store builder, image upload, catalog management

• Vendor Central: A+ Content submission and content approval workflows

• Brand Registry tools and Amazon A+ Content guidelines



Supplemental tools:

• Canva (for quick edits or templated assets only)

• Google Drive or equivalent cloud storage for asset organization

• ClickUp or Asana for task and project tracking



Qualifications

• 2 to 3 years of experience specifically in Amazon graphic design (A+ Content, product images, Brand Store)

• Demonstrable portfolio of Amazon A+ Content and product listing creative

• Hands-on experience uploading and managing content in Seller Central or Vendor Central

• Strong eye for detail, especially in spotting errors, misalignments, or compliance issues in existing content

• Ability to manage multiple client accounts and concurrent projects without a drop in quality

• Solid understanding of eCommerce visual hierarchy and conversion-focused design

• Comfortable working remotely and independently within a pod-based team structure



About TaskOn eCommerce

TaskOn is a Klaviyo Master Platinum Partner and full-execution retention marketing agency serving 7 to 8 figure DTC brands across Amazon, Shopify, Klaviyo, Wayfair, and WooCommerce. We operate in a pod-based model where small, specialized teams own client relationships end to end. We do not advise and walk away. We execute. If you want to do real work on real brands at scale, this is the place.



To Apply: Submit your resume and a complete portfolio of your Amazon A+ Content work. To be considered, your application message must include the phrase "I am an Amazon A+ Star!" in your introduction. Applications without a portfolio or without this phrase will not be reviewed.

title: E-commerce Finance & Bookkeeping Manager
description:
About the Role



Our e-commerce businesses need a sharp, dependable finance person to own our day-to-day money operations. Think invoices and payments, our accounts-payable inbox, QuickBooks upkeep, reconciliations across Wise, PayPal, banks and processors, inventory tracking, reporting, and a hand in cash-flow forecasting down the line.

A heads-up: this isn't a checklist job. We're after someone who takes real ownership — spots the thing that looks off, digs into discrepancies, and flags surprises before they snowball.



What You'll Own



Invoices & accounts payable



Run the accounts-payable Gmail inbox and keep it organized with labels

Track vendor and contractor invoices: amounts, currencies, due dates, payment status

Catch duplicates, errors, and anything that smells suspicious



Payments



Prepare payments via Wise, PayPal, and bank accounts

Monitor what's scheduled, paid, failed, or overdue



Books & reconciliation



Keep QuickBooks clean and current

Reconcile banks, credit cards, Wise, PayPal, Shopify, and payment processors

Track Shopify sales, refunds, chargebacks, fees, and payouts

Stay on top of processor reserves, holds, and delayed payouts



Inventory



Track stock levels and movements

Reconcile inventory against Shopify, suppliers, and warehouses

Manage purchase orders, supplier deposits, and incoming stock

Maintain inventory valuation, COGS, and landed-cost records



Reporting & planning



Track ad spend, shipping, fulfillment, software, and processing costs

Deliver weekly and monthly financial reports

Surface unpaid invoices, upcoming payments, and cash needs

Support cash-flow forecasting, budgeting, and planning

Keep documents tidy for accountants and tax season



What We're Looking For



A background in finance, bookkeeping, or accounting

E-commerce or DTC experience, ideally with 7–8 figure revenue brands

Solid QuickBooks skills

Hands-on with Wise, PayPal, Shopify, and online banking

Strong with spreadsheets

Comfortable with inventory, COGS, and reconciliations

Detail-obsessed

High initiative — you solve problems without being told to

Clear written English and reliable follow-through

Trustworthy with sensitive financial information



Speaking Up



When something unexpected happens, we need to hear about it fast. That includes missing or duplicate invoices, odd charges, changes to vendor payment details, failed or delayed payments, missing payouts, reconciliation gaps, processor reserves or account holds, inventory shortfalls, sudden cost spikes, or anything that looks fishy.

A good report covers four things: what happened, the financial impact, what you looked into, and what you'd do next.

What We're Looking For



A background in finance, bookkeeping, or accounting

E-commerce or DTC experience

Solid QuickBooks skills

Hands-on with Wise, PayPal, Shopify, and online banking

Strong with spreadsheets

Comfortable with inventory, COGS, and reconciliations

Detail-obsessed

High initiative — you solve problems without being told to

Clear written English and reliable follow-through

Trustworthy with sensitive financial information



How We Handle Security



You'll prepare payments, but final approval always stays with management. And any change to a vendor's banking details must be independently verified before a payment goes out.



To Apply



Tell us:



-A quick summary of your e-commerce finance or bookkeeping background

-The software and payment platforms you've worked with

-Your experience with QuickBooks, inventory, and reconciliations

-A time you caught and resolved a financial discrepancy

-Your availability and expected hourly rate

-Your MBTI type

s
